meta.name: VIGIL Design Tokens
meta.description: Color, type, space, radius, shadow and motion tokens for the VIGIL screen redesign. Every color token ships light and dark values; dark is the real app-shell navy, not an inverted theme. Mirrored in CSS at assets/tokens.css.

color.name: canvas
color.usage: Page / app background. Dark is the real app-shell navy — a night mode, not an inverted palette.

color.name: panel
color.usage: Cards, bottom sheets, wells — anything one layer above canvas.

color.name: border
color.usage: Hairlines only — dividers, resting card outlines. Never a control's primary edge.

color.name: border-strong
color.usage: Every interactive control's edge (inputs, buttons, option rows). Meets 3:1 minimum against its background.

color.name: ink-muted
color.usage: Secondary text, captions, helper copy. Meets 7:1 against canvas/panel.

color.name: primary
color.usage: Primary buttons, selected states, active nav. Flips in dark mode so filled buttons stay readable against the navy canvas.

color.name: on-primary
color.usage: Text / icons drawn on a primary-filled surface.

color.name: ice
color.usage: The one repeated calm tint — icon circles, the trend baseline band, the crisis entry's resting fill.

color.name: on-ice
color.usage: Text / icons on an ice-filled surface.

color.name: ice-strong
color.usage: Second attention tier (e.g. 'reach out this week'), and pressed states for ice surfaces.

color.name: coral
color.usage: URGENT / CRISIS ONLY — the 112 call button and the top counselor alert tier. Never decorative, never used for ordinary errors.

color.name: on-coral
color.usage: Text / icons on a coral surface. Same ink both modes — coral stays light enough in dark mode too.

color.name: coral-tint
color.usage: Soft background for urgent-tier rows and badges — the coral feeling without full-saturation coral.

color.name: focus-ring
color.usage: Solid 3px ring, 3px offset, on every focusable element. Matches primary so focus never competes with a status color.

color.name: scrim
color.usage: Backdrop behind the crisis sheet and other modal surfaces.

families.name: font-serif
families.usage: Headings only — greetings, question titles, card/section headers, the VIGIL wordmark.

families.name: font-sans
families.usage: Everything else — body copy, labels, captions.

scale.name: display
scale.usage: Greetings and confirmations — one per screen, at most.

scale.name: body-lg
scale.usage: Lead text — the one sentence that matters most on a screen.

scale.name: body
scale.usage: Default reading size. Never smaller than this for anything a person must read.

scale.name: caption
scale.usage: Timestamps and status text only — the size floor. Never used for anything a person must read to act.

space.name: space-3
space.usage: Compact stack spacing, icon-circle to text in a row.

space.name: space-4
space.usage: Default stack spacing, card inner padding on narrow screens.

space.name: touch-min
space.usage: Minimum tap target on every person-facing screen.

space.name: touch-min-counselor
space.usage: Minimum tap target in the denser counselor dashboard only.

shadow.name: shadow-soft
shadow.usage: Phone frames, resting panels — barely visible. Importance is never carried by shadow.

shadow.name: shadow-sheet
shadow.usage: Bottom sheets presented over the scrim (e.g. the crisis sheet).

easings.name: ease-out-arrival
easings.usage: Things entering the screen — rows rising, cards arriving.

easings.name: ease-in-place
easings.usage: Things moving within the screen — question slide, tab switch.

durations.name: quick
durations.usage: Micro feedback — option fill, button press.

durations.name: base
durations.usage: Standard transitions — card swap, tier change.

durations.name: slow
durations.usage: The submit check-mark draw, the ice halo pulse.

motion.reducedMotion: All durations collapse to 1ms, stagger to 0, the sync ring holds at partial opacity instead of breathing, and view transitions are skipped — state still changes, just instantly.
